title: Chemical dosing package
goal: A process engineer can trace prepared chemical through a metering pump and calibration column to a pH-controlled injection point.

rubric.must: TK-701, AG-701, P-701, C-701, FV-701, NRV-701, and V-702 form a visible dosing path.
AT-701 and AIC-701 visibly connect to FV-701 with electric measurement and pneumatic command lines.
The vertical C-701 calibration column is visibly between P-701 and XV-701.
FT-701 and FI-701 are visibly associated with C-701 and connected by an electric signal line.
NRV-701 is visibly downstream of FV-701 before the process mixing header.
FV-701 visibly shows a diaphragm actuator and FC fail position.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 visibly satisfies all six rules, while Image 2 changes the equipment identities, dosing topology, and control scheme.
